children.value: serial 0x51BC58AA, sequence 2, granule 24000, end of stream

findings.message: STREAMINFO does not say how many samples the stream holds (the count is 0, as an encoder writes it when it cannot seek back); the frames hold 24000.
The MD5 of the audio in STREAMINFO is 0, which means the encoder did not know it; the audio cannot be checked against it.
